$comment: flux-expr/1 conformance vectors (EXPR-SPEC 5). Each vector carries an expression, the scope it is written in, the model fragment it is checked against, and the expected outcome. 'model_fragment' names an entry of the top-level 'models' table rather than repeating the fragment inline. 'expect.parse' is the canonical AST object, or the error code when the text does not parse; 'expect.check' is 'ok' or the static-check error code; 'expect.unparse' is the canonical text; 'expect.eval' is a list of {row, result} cases (the spec's singular form is the one-element case). Row values are encoded by their declared type: number as a decimal string, set<string> as an array, string and enum as a string, bool as a boolean, null as null. No JSON numbers appear anywhere in this file.
